description: Log a manual (past) time entry. Provide either `duration` (relative to now), or both `startTime` and `endTime` (absolute ISO-8601 timestamps).

duration.description: How long the work took. Accepts "1h", "45m", "1h30m", "1.5h", "1:30", or "90" (interpreted as minutes).

endTime.description: ISO-8601 end time. Required if duration is omitted.

project.description: Project id (UUID) or exact project name.

rate.description: Optional rate id or exact rate name (e.g. "Software Development").

startTime.description: ISO-8601 start time (e.g. "2026-05-04T09:00:00Z"). Required if duration is omitted.

name: log_time
